legacy_migration.coverage: Exterior/threshold or room master → arrival-side single → work-zone single → one visible approach/reposition → shared-distance frame → script-assigned single.
legacy_migration.blocking: Lock project-original entry, booth/table and work-zone IDs; assign stable screen sides; stage any overlap/contact only if the script specifies it and preserve a safe readable gap otherwise.
legacy_migration.pacing_edit: Let the room map register before alternating faces; hold the first shared-distance frame long enough to read both body positions; accelerate only for script-verified information changes.

legacy_migration.non_applicability: Do not use when geography should remain deliberately withheld, the meeting begins already intimate, one person never enters the other’s zone, or physical approach is unsafe/unwanted.

legacy_migration.trigger: A locked project-original script assigns a sustained two-person exchange in which distance or temporary absence changes while neither performer needs large action; dialogue/reaction ownership and emotion require script/sound evidence.
legacy_migration.directing_decision: Alternate shared table geography and restrained singles, then use a complete walk-away/environmental interval to expand distance before a visible return/foreground approach contracts it again.
legacy_migration.coverage: Shared master → script-assigned restrained singles → complete leave path → environmental/room hold → seated-side anchor → visible return/foreground passage → shared or opposite single.
legacy_migration.blocking: Lock project-original table sides, chairs, aisle/work zone and return path; limit each beat to one gross head/hand/posture change; keep eye targets UNKNOWN until storyboard/script defines them.
legacy_migration.pacing_edit: Prefer longer holds when action is minimal; cut only on script-verified information ownership or completed gross movement; allow an environmental hold to carry absence instead of inventing extra facial beats.
legacy_migration.sound: SND-UNK: audio was not auditioned; dialogue, room tone, music, object/door/bell/vehicle cues, off-screen cues, sound bridges and sound-led cut/performance timing UNKNOWN; burned subtitles excluded.
legacy_migration.applicability: Quiet negotiation, reunion, reconciliation attempt, confession setup or meal scenes where the locked script makes proximity and absence structurally relevant.
legacy_migration.non_applicability: Do not use when rapid tactical information requires dense coverage, performers must cross unpredictably, the exchange is one-sided, or environmental holds would obscure urgent action.
legacy_migration.failure_mode: Alternation becomes metronomic; minimal faces are over-labeled as emotion; walk-away path is truncated; return side flips; every shot copies reference timing/composition; distance changes without script purpose.
legacy_migration.counterexample: COUNTEREXAMPLE UNKNOWN: same-trigger contrary source pending. SOURCE-OBSERVED different-trigger context exclusion: S020–S031 are task/object inserts where distance contraction/expansion is not the visible organizing problem.
legacy_migration.unknown: Dialogue, speaker/reaction ownership, relationship/reconciliation/desire, emotional state, exact eye targets, reason for leaving/returning, sound/music and same-trigger contrary source.
legacy_migration.ai_risk: camera=MEDIUM: stable shared/single geometry plus readable leave/return paths; performance=HIGH: sparse asynchronous gross actions without emotion imitation; continuity=HIGH: screen sides, table objects, distance, absence/return path and wardrobe.
legacy_migration.fallback: Project-original locked-script fallback: fixed neutral two-person master → two fixed singles only at script-assigned information changes → fixed wide showing one complete exit or return; cap actions at one head/hand change and lock original zone/screen-side/object states.
legacy_migration.confidence: 0.80 HIGH for visible distance/coverage/pacing structure; LOW for dialogue and relationship meaning; single-source candidate only

legacy_migration.trigger: A locked project-original script verifies that a small held object changes what one person knows or must decide; the object’s content, owner and relationship significance cannot be inferred from this source picture.
legacy_migration.directing_decision: Show the object only after the script-verified reveal action begins, hold until gross layout/content category is readable, then cut back to the script-assigned face/body before resuming exchange coverage.
legacy_migration.coverage: Table geography → hand/object entry → readable object insert → designated receiver single → opposite single or shared master.
legacy_migration.blocking: Lock project-original object ID, open/closed orientation, hand side, table position and receiver screen side; use abstract/original content and never reproduce the source photo-like image or personal likeness.
legacy_migration.pacing_edit: Give the insert only the duration needed for project-original information legibility; the next face/body hold must not require a copied micro-expression; sound timing remains project-specific.
legacy_migration.sound: SND-UNK: audio was not auditioned; dialogue, room tone, music, object/door/bell/vehicle cues, off-screen cues, sound bridges and sound-led cut/performance timing UNKNOWN; burned subtitles excluded.
legacy_migration.applicability: Letters, devices, tokens, plans or images where a locked script explicitly changes information through a small object.
legacy_migration.non_applicability: Do not use when object content must remain hidden, no person receives new information, the object is merely decoration, or privacy/likeness rights are unresolved.
legacy_migration.failure_mode: Insert appears before context; content is unreadable or copied; ownership is assumed; next face is mislabeled as a reaction; continuity flips hand/object orientation; the insert overstates a minor prop.
legacy_migration.counterexample: COUNTEREXAMPLE UNKNOWN: same-trigger contrary source pending. SOURCE-OBSERVED different-trigger context exclusion: S076 bell-like insert marks a threshold rather than a verified information reveal.
legacy_migration.unknown: Object content/person/owner, script information change, receiver identity, dialogue, emotion/reaction cause, sound cue, exact eye target, audience effect and same-trigger contrary source.
legacy_migration.ai_risk: camera=MEDIUM: readable small-object geometry and face return; performance=HIGH: restrained receiver action without copied expression; continuity=HIGH: object version/orientation, hand side, table position and receiver screen side.
legacy_migration.fallback: Project-original locked-script fallback: fixed insert of an original non-personal abstract document/device/token with one script-locked visible change → fixed neutral receiver medium; remove likeness/photo detail, lock object/hand/table IDs, and do not copy the reference composition.
legacy_migration.confidence: 0.74 MEDIUM-HIGH for visible insert-to-face ordering; LOW for object meaning and reaction causality; single-source candidate only
